title: Require Service Contract Authority
forbids: a root contract outside the shared base lineage, a module contract index without a direct semantic leaf, a module-named mega-leaf that preserves the aggregate behind another file, a contract leaf whose sole export does not match its filename, exported parallel schema authority, raw TypeBox procedure schemas, imported error-map authority, or TypeBox capabilities that cannot project through the service boundary
why: The service contract is one aggregate over module-owned semantic leaves. Each leaf owns one procedure or coherent semantic group plus its private request, response, envelope, and helper schemas; the module name belongs only to the aggregate and cannot masquerade as a leaf. Genuinely reusable DTO schemas move to model/dto, while local declarations cross the oRPC boundary through the pinned Standard Schema bridge. TypeScript and Knip own unused private declarations without a Habitat-only schema registry.
remediate: Compose the root with base.router, aggregate direct semantic contract leaves from contract/index.ts, split any module-named capsule along the module's procedure or coherent semantic-group boundaries, keep one filename-matched export per leaf, keep local TypeBox support private, move only reusable DTO schemas to model/dto, wrap every procedure input and output with standard(...), and keep error additions inline or in one private local map.
message: Service contracts must preserve one aggregate, direct semantic leaves, and Standard Schema authority.
